build.name: build via platforms/unix make
build.cmd: cd platforms/unix && make -s 2>&1 | grep -viE 'warning' | tail -3; ls pforth pforth_standalone 2>/dev/null; test -x pforth || test -x pforth_standalone

notes: 7 sq -> 49 checks the threaded inner interpreter and the data stack. pforth builds a dictionary image (pforth.dic) at first run; the standalone binary embeds it.
